mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tags WHERE status = 'enabled' ORDER BY category ASC, id ASC

SELECT dt.drama_id AS drama_id, t.id AS tag_id, t.name_en AS name_en, t.name_zh AS name_zh, t.category AS category, t.status AS status FROM drama_tags dt JOIN tags t ON t.id = dt.tag_id WHERE t.status = 'enabled' AND dt.drama_id IN #{dramaId} ORDER BY t.id
